notes.subject: אות
notes.rationale: Sengwalwa se šomiša sehlaga sa leswao (signal/omen), e sego aleph-tav ⟨את⟩ — diphuthelwana tše dintši di sekametše go 'token for good' ya KJV; tlhaka e swana eupša lentšu le fapana.

notes.subject: ויבשו
notes.rationale: Seheberu se bolela 'go tsena mokgopolo / go fifala' (go boshwa); 'ba be le dihlong' ke mokgwa wa go bolela woo o theilwego godimo ga bokao, sebopego se lahlegile.

notes.subject: go Yahwe
notes.rationale: Motho oa thapelo o bolela ka go lebanya go Yahwe, motho oa lentswe la kagiso e timetsego le motho oa leina la hae oa thuso le kagiso e timetsego.

translation: Dira le nna leswao la bobotle, gomme bao ba nkhloilego ba le bone gomme ba be le dihlong, ka gobane wena, Yahwe, o nthušitše gomme o mphomotše.
